germĭnātus , ūs, m. id.,
I.a sprouting forth, putting forth, germination (less freq. than germinatio): “oleam, si capra depaverit primo germinatu, sterilescere,” Plin. 15, 8, 8, § 34 : “serotino quaedam germinatu florent maturantque celeriter,” id. 16, 25, 41, § 102 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
